parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides deeper personalization with explicit references to multiple profile attributes (income, expenses, loss comfort, liabilities, experience) and stronger diversification analysis comparing tech weight to S&P 500 benchmarks. System A has cleaner risk_level alignment (moderate matching moderate tolerance) and fewer questionable tickers (B's VGRO/VMOD/VCON in A are also suspect, but B mislabels rebalance/bond recs as low risk), but B's overall depth, evidence-based rationale, and trade-off analysis outweigh these issues.
